title: LDAP account locked after password rotation
description: After our quarterly password rotation policy kicked in, approximately 40 users in the Finance department got locked out of their accounts. The lockout policy (3 failed attempts in 15 minutes) is triggering because their cached credentials on Windows workstations are trying the old password. Need to either unlock all accounts in bulk or extend the lockout threshold during rotation windows.

title: SSO loop — redirects between IdP and SP infinitely
description: Users trying to access the HR portal are stuck in an infinite redirect loop between our SAML IdP (Azure AD) and the service provider. Browser shows 'too many redirects' after about 10 cycles. Started after the SP updated their ACS URL yesterday. The SAML RelayState parameter seems to be getting dropped on the return trip.

title: Service account svc-monitoring has excessive privileges
description: Security audit flagged that svc-monitoring (used by Prometheus) has Domain Admin privileges in Active Directory. This account only needs read access to query LDAP for service discovery. Risk: if the monitoring server is compromised, attacker gets full domain admin access. Need to create a least-privilege service account and rotate credentials.

title: MFA bypass for VPN — users can authenticate without second factor
description: Discovered that the Cisco AnyConnect VPN integration with our MFA provider has a configuration gap. Users connecting via the legacy VPN client (v4.9) are not being challenged for MFA — only the new client (v4.10+) enforces it. About 30% of our remote workforce is still on the old client. This is a compliance violation for SOC2.

title: Group nesting too deep — token bloat causing auth failures
description: Users in the Engineering department are getting 'HTTP 400 Bad Request' when accessing internal web apps. Investigation shows their Kerberos tokens exceed the 12KB MaxTokenSize because they're members of 300+ nested AD groups. The group nesting goes 8 levels deep due to years of uncleaned group-of-groups structure.

title: Azure AD Connect sync stuck in staging mode
description: Azure AD Connect has been stuck in staging mode since the last server restart 3 days ago. On-prem AD changes (new users, group changes, password resets) are not syncing to Azure AD. Cloud-only apps using Azure AD for auth are showing stale user data. 15 new hires created this week cannot access any cloud resources.

title: OAuth refresh token lifetime too long — security risk
description: Our OAuth2 configuration for the customer portal has refresh tokens set to never expire. A penetrated refresh token from a terminated employee was used to access customer data 6 months after their departure. Need to implement token lifetime policies: 24h for access tokens, 7 days for refresh tokens, and revoke all existing tokens for terminated users.

title: LDAP query performance degraded — 5 second response times
description: LDAP queries from the application tier are taking 5+ seconds instead of the usual 50ms. The prod-ldap-01 server shows CPU at 95% due to unindexed LDAP searches. The auth-service is doing subtree searches with (memberOf=*) filter across the entire directory tree instead of using the Global Catalog on port 3268.

title: Conditional Access policy blocking legitimate users
description: After deploying new Conditional Access policies in Azure AD, users connecting from the India office (ap-south-1 region) are being blocked with 'Your sign-in was blocked due to conditional access policies'. The named location for India office IP ranges was not updated after the ISP changed our public IP block last week.
error_codes: AADSTS53003: Access blocked by Conditional Access

title: SCIM provisioning failing — users not created in SaaS apps
description: SCIM provisioning from Azure AD to Slack, Jira, and Confluence has stopped working. New users added to the 'SaaS-Users' group in AD are not being provisioned in these applications. The SCIM bearer token expired and auto-renewal failed silently. 22 users provisioned in the last 2 weeks are missing from SaaS apps.

title: Password hash sync broken — cloud password reset not working
description: Users who reset their password via the Azure AD self-service portal can log into cloud apps but cannot log into on-prem systems. Password hash sync from Azure AD back to on-prem AD is failing with 'password writeback error'. The Azure AD Connect service account password was changed without updating the connector configuration.

title: Cross-domain trust broken after DC promotion
description: After promoting a new domain controller in the child domain (dev.company.local), the two-way trust with the parent domain (company.local) broke. Users in the dev domain can no longer access resources in the parent domain. Trust validation fails with 'The target account name is incorrect'. Likely a DNS or SPN issue.

title: Guest user access not expiring in SharePoint
description: External guest users invited to SharePoint sites still have access months after their access should have expired. The guest access expiration policy (30 days) is configured in Azure AD but not being enforced. Access reviews show 150+ external guests with active access who should have been removed.

title: JWT token validation failing after key rotation
description: Internal microservices are rejecting JWTs issued by the auth-service after the signing key was rotated. The JWKS endpoint is serving the new key but services have cached the old public key. Services using jose library with 1-hour JWKS cache TTL are affected. Manual cache invalidation needed across 12 services.

title: Orphaned SIDs in ACLs after domain migration
description: After migrating users from the old domain to the new domain, file share ACLs still contain SIDs from the old domain that cannot be resolved. Users see 'Account Unknown (S-1-5-21-xxx)' entries in file permissions. About 200 shared folders are affected. Need SID history migration or ACL remediation.

title: API gateway not forwarding user identity headers
description: The API gateway (Kong) is stripping the X-Forwarded-User and X-User-Groups headers when proxying requests to backend services. Backend services receive anonymous requests and cannot enforce RBAC. Started after the gateway plugin update yesterday. Affects all authenticated API routes.

title: RADIUS authentication timeout for WiFi users
description: Corporate WiFi users are getting disconnected every 2 hours when RADIUS re-authentication times out. The NPS (Network Policy Server) on prod-ldap-01 is taking too long to validate credentials against AD because the LDAP connection pool is exhausted. WiFi controller retries for 30 seconds then drops the session.

title: Privileged access workstation (PAW) policy not enforcing
description: The Group Policy restricting admin account usage to Privileged Access Workstations is not being applied. Domain admins can still log into regular workstations, which violates our tiered admin model. GPResult shows the policy is being filtered out by a conflicting WMI filter that was added during last month's cleanup.

title: SAML NameID format mismatch causing duplicate accounts
description: New SSO integration with the CRM vendor is creating duplicate user accounts. Our IdP sends NameID as email format (user@company.com) but the SP expects persistent format (opaque UUID). Each login creates a new account instead of matching the existing one. 50 duplicate accounts created in the last week.

title: Kerberos delegation misconfigured — double-hop failure
description: The reporting application on prod-app-01 cannot query the database on prod-db-01 using Windows Integrated Auth. The first hop (user to app) works but the second hop (app to DB) fails with 'Login failed for user NT AUTHORITY\ANONYMOUS LOGON'. Constrained delegation is configured but the SPN for the SQL service is missing.

title: Fine-grained password policy not applying to service accounts OU
description: The fine-grained password policy (PSO) that enforces 24-character minimum for service accounts is not being applied. Service accounts in the 'OU=ServiceAccounts' are falling back to the default domain policy (8-char minimum). The PSO precedence value is set higher than another conflicting PSO. Audit finding — needs immediate fix.

title: Certificate-based auth failing after CA renewal
description: Smart card authentication for the security operations team stopped working after the enterprise CA certificate was renewed. The new CA cert is not in the NTAuth store in Active Directory. Users with smart cards get 'The system could not log you on. Your credentials could not be verified.' Windows Event ID 4771 shows KDC_ERR_CLIENT_NOT_TRUSTED.

title: AD account provisioning webhook failing silently
description: The HR system (Workday) sends webhooks to our provisioning API when new employees are onboarded. The webhook endpoint on prod-app-01 is returning 200 OK but not actually creating the AD account. The issue is a null pointer in the UPN generation logic when the employee's last name contains an apostrophe (e.g., O'Brien). 3 new hires stuck without accounts.

title: Emergency break-glass account password unknown
description: During a DR drill, we discovered that the emergency break-glass admin account (admin-breakglass@company.com) password stored in the vault has been rotated but the vault was not updated. We cannot access the account. This is the only account that bypasses Conditional Access and MFA. Need to reset via DSRM or similar recovery method.

title: LDAPS certificate expired — secure LDAP connections failing
description: The LDAPS (LDAP over SSL) certificate on prod-ldap-01 expired yesterday. All applications using LDAPS (port 636) for secure directory queries are failing. Applications using plain LDAP (port 389) still work but are sending credentials in cleartext. Need to renew the LDAPS cert and restart the AD DS service.

title: Access review campaign stuck at 60% completion
description: The quarterly access review campaign in Azure AD Identity Governance is stuck. 40% of reviewers have not completed their reviews and the deadline is tomorrow. The reminder emails stopped sending because the mail relay was throttling. Need to send manual reminders and consider extending the deadline by 48 hours.

title: PIM role activation delays — 30 minute wait for admin access
description: Azure AD Privileged Identity Management (PIM) role activations are taking 30+ minutes instead of the expected 5 minutes. Engineers needing temporary admin access for production issues are blocked. The Azure AD backend appears to be experiencing latency. Workaround: using the break-glass account, which defeats the purpose of PIM.

title: RBAC role inheritance not working in Kubernetes namespaces
description: ClusterRole bindings in Kubernetes are not properly inheriting to namespace-level roles. Users assigned the 'developer' ClusterRole can access resources in the 'default' namespace but get 403 in project-specific namespaces. The RoleBinding aggregation labels are missing from the namespace-scoped roles.

title: Expired client certificate blocking API integrations
description: Third-party API integrations using mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication stopped working. The client certificate issued to our integration service expired 2 days ago. Affects payment gateway, shipping provider, and inventory management APIs. Need to generate new CSR, get cert signed by partner CA, and update all 3 integration configs.

title: AD group cleanup needed — 500+ empty groups
description: Active Directory contains over 500 security groups with zero members. These were created for past projects and never cleaned up. They slow down group policy processing, clutter the directory, and make access reviews take 3x longer. Need to identify which are truly unused vs. referenced in ACLs, then archive or delete.
